sum: Valor Energy Inc. engages in the automobile transaction and related services business in the People's Republic of China. It also provides car rental services to individual customers; and auto finance solutions through financing leases. In addition, the company engages in automobile sales comprising sale of new purchased or used cars; and the provision of supporting services. Further, the company offers new energy vehicles leasing, and management services; and automobile purchase services, such as credit assessment, installation of GPS devices, ride-hailing driver qualification, and other administrative procedures. The company was formerly known as Senmiao Technology Limitedand change its name to .Valor Energy Inc. in August 2026. Valor Energy Inc. was founded in 2014 and is based in Chengdu, the People's Republic of China.
